def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)

def has_perms_owner_aware(user, perms, obj):
    """
    Legacy slow path (guardian-backed) single-object permission check.

    The queryset-filtering side of this migrated onto
    ``PermittedObjectsFilter``/``permitted_object_ids()``, but this
    single-object check still has many production callers. Several callers
    remain across ``documents/``, ``paperless_mail/``, and ``paperless_ai/``
    -- grep for this function name before removing it.
    """
    checker = ObjectPermissionChecker(user)
    return obj.owner is None or obj.owner == user or checker.has_perm(perms, obj)

This is source_supported_failure, not a repository-wide completeness claim; source discovery remains not-tested.

facts.statement: DocumentViewSet.download dispatches the requested download to file_response with attachment disposition.
The authorization check uses request.user as the caller identity when resolving the requested document.
The requested pk is bound to request_doc, and root_doc is derived from that requested document before authorization.
The strongest visible authorization control applies has_perms_owner_aware to root_doc with view_document and returns forbidden when it fails.
The owner-aware check succeeds only when the object has no owner, the object owner is the user, or the object-level permission check succeeds.
The file-serving path is conditional on the root authorization gate not returning HttpResponseForbidden.
Only after the gate does the handler select file_doc and call serve_file with that document.
serve_file serves the selected document's archive_file when archive use is enabled, otherwise its source_file.
